title: SCPN ICF Impact Core
description: Governed device-family repository for the projectile/impact inertial confinement fusion configuration within the SCPN Reactor Systems Research Group. Evidence maturity computational_prototype: a validated device configuration model, diagnostic and clock semantics aligned with the SCPN Phase Orchestrator observability catalogue, level-0 device physics (what a flying plate carries onto its target, the fuel of the two published target geometries, and where that fuel ends up when compressed), and tessellated and B-rep models of both published schemes. All parameter sets are synthetic or anchored on a freely published workshop proceedings; no real machine is described, and the claim inventory is empty.
